items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: Incidentally, I'm a junior. I'm named after my father.

ctx.x: And what street did you grow up on?

Where? Well, I lived on both sides of the river. First, I was born on Tex Street in Algiers on the west bank of the river. And then my mother moved to, well, we were living in Gretna on the west bank of the river. I was on 5th Street right across from Hebe's Old Bakery where my mother and father separated. Well, we moved over here into the Irish Channel, 515 Third Street. Well, incidentally, Ted, I went up that way about three or four months ago to look at the old house that I used to live in. But it's a…
Could you tell me something about your father and your father's family?
